title: Aardvark-Vanaheim Cerebus #85 April 1986 Comic Book - Dave Sim - ISSN 0712-7774
descriptionText: The Aardvark-Vanaheim Cerebus #85 April 1986 comic book, written and illustrated by Dave Sim, is a vintage piece from the Copper Age of US Comics. This collectible item features the character Cerebus in a classic comic book format, making it a sought-after item for fans and collectors alike. Published by Aardvark-Vanaheim in the United States, this comic book is a part of the Cerebus series and holds a unique place in the world of comics and graphic novels.
